dogecoin.text:
I’ve believed in tokens with bold visions —  
only to realize that belief clouded my judgment.  
Some just faded into the background.

Memecoins don’t pretend. That’s why I notice them.

$DOGE $SHIB $PEPE $FLOKI $BONK $WIF $PENGU $GOAT $LOFI  
#CryptoMindset #Memecoins

$DOT, $HOT, $AR, $ICP had strong tech —
interoperability, storage, Web3 internet.
But they failed to gain liquidity.

$DOGE, $PEPE had no tech, just memes.
Still, they flooded with capital.

In crypto, code doesn't move price.
Capital does.

#Altcoins #Memecoins #NarrativePower
